changelog: **The job worker (#1673):** a generic loop runs every queued job whose name has a registered handler (`src/jobs/index.ts` → `src/lib/jobs/registry.ts`): claim with `SKIP LOCKED` into free capacity (`JOBS_CONCURRENCY`, default 2), run under a per-job timeout with an `AbortSignal`, write one `JobRun` per attempt carrying the job's new `Job.trigger` (`schedule` | `manual` | `boot`), then `SUCCEEDED`, or a retry with jittered exponential backoff (30 s doubling to 1 h, `src/lib/jobs/workerRule.ts`), or `DEAD_LETTER` after `maxAttempts` with `lastError`, one `logger.error` and one `job.dead_letter` ActivityLog row. Every settle is one guarded `updateMany` on the claim (`status = RUNNING AND lockedBy = me`); a heartbeat keeps `lockedAt` fresh on long jobs. Ticked every 5 s on every replica via `POST /api/jobs/worker/tick` (the mail drain's pattern, no lease); the tick's request stays open until its jobs settle, so Next's SIGTERM drain waits for them, and a SIGTERM hook releases whatever is still running after 20 s. Queued names with no handler are logged at worker start. `JOBS_WORKER_ENABLED=0` is the kill switch (the deploy canary sets it). Docs: `docs/job-worker.md`.
